variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: The leader of {party} is being challenged. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question

variants.body: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
